ui.inertia-navigation: Downgraded, not disabled: the twelve remaining hits stay visible in every report.
What the rule is right about: `axios.post(...)` followed by a manual page reload skips the
Inertia progress bar, flash toasts, the dirty-state guard and the back button. That is a real
antipattern and this addon does not do it — the two row-action screens already refresh through
`router.reload()`, so navigation and history stay inside Inertia.
What the twelve hits actually are: calls into this addon's JSON API (routes/cp.php, the
`api.*` group — 32 routes that never render a page and are documented as such at the top of
that file). Seven of them are the canvas builder's RPC loop: save/create return the new id,
validate returns the issue list, test and test-node return a run transcript that is rendered
inline next to the node. `router.post()` cannot carry a response body back to the caller; it
expects an Inertia page response and errors on anything else. Converting these means
redesigning the client/server contract of the whole builder — 32 endpoints, AutomationsApiTest,
ApiSmokeTest, OptionsEndpointTest and the Vitest component suite. That is a v2 architecture
decision for Adrian, not a hardening change, and it is filed as one.
Precedent in core: statamic/cms 6 ships the same shape it forbids here —
resources/js/pages/users/Passkeys.vue:40 is `axios.delete(url).then(() => router.reload())`,
and pages/users/OAuth.vue:29 is the same. Core has 17 axios mutations against 15 router ones.
A blanket ban is stricter than core's own practice.
Fixed rather than excused: the docblock false positive in composables/useNodeOptions.js (a
comment, not a call), and every URL that was invented on the client by rewriting another URL
(Automations/Index.vue's templates link, Runs/Show.vue's node retry, Templates/Index.vue's
post-install redirect) — those now come from the server and are pinned by
tests/Feature/CpLinkTargetsTest.php.
